name: sada-iraq
description: صدى العراق — Railway Node.js service with Netlify compatibility

scripts.test: node scripts/validate-release.js && node --check server.js && node --check tests/performance-release.test.js && node tests/performance-release.test.js && node tests/orders-index-fallback.test.js && node tests/auth-email-login.test.js && node tests/custom-shop-release.test.js && node tests/custom-shop-order-flow.test.js && node tests/ban-enforcement.test.js && node tests/database-management.test.js && node tests/admin-account.test.js && node tests/provider-auto-sync.test.js && node tests/order-details-messaging.test.js && node tests/storefront-and-live-refresh.test.js
scripts.build: node --check server.js && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const f of ['server.js','index.html','package.json','config.json']) { if (!fs.existsSync(f)) throw new Error('Missing required root file: '+f); } JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('config.json','utf8')); console.log('Railway build preflight passed (root-only safe; nested scripts/tests are optional for deployment)');"
